name: files-pane-fast-light
brief:
## Goal
Make the Files experience in forge-control-web genuinely fast and fully correct in light mode. Konrad's words: 'when I click the file section, things still lag and they still don't work in light mode.' This is the overnight proving run for goal mode — quality over speed, but it must be DONE and DEPLOYED by morning.

## Context
Repos inside this worktree: forge-control (Hono API on :7700, tsx runtime) and forge-control-web (Next 15 + React 19, served by pm2 process forge-control-web). The Files UI lives under forge-control-web/app/desktop/ — grep for FileExplorerPanel and the files API routes in forge-control/src/routes/files.ts. Design tokens are CSS variables defined in forge-control-web/app/tokens.ts — the light theme swaps variable values, so any hardcoded hex/rgb in Files components is a bug by definition. Suspects for the lag: fetching too much per click (full directory trees, stat calls), no caching, no virtualization for large directories, blocking renders. Profile before fixing: measure the actual click-to-render path (API timing via curl, component re-renders) and write the findings into the planning corpus.

## Definition of done
- Clicking into the Files section renders visibly within ~200ms on typical directories; large directories (1000+ entries) stay responsive (virtualized or paginated — no frozen main thread).
- No API call in the click path fetches recursively more than the directory being viewed.
- Zero hardcoded colors in Files components — every color reads a token variable; the pane is verified readable and consistent in BOTH light and dark themes.
- npx tsc --noEmit clean in forge-control AND forge-control-web; npm run build passes in forge-control-web.

## Quality bar
The phase reviewer must actually run: tsc in both repos, the web build, curl timings against the files API endpoints, and a grep for hardcoded hex/rgb/hsl literals in the touched components. A review without executed checks is a NEEDS_FIXES on itself.

## Constraints / hard rules
- Design tokens only; never hardcode colors.
- pnpm repos: NODE_ENV=development pnpm add X --prod=false. Never plain npm install.
- NEVER restart or touch forge-executor. Restarting forge-control and forge-control-web is allowed.
- Do not redesign the desktop shell: DesktopApp.tsx and app/desktop/live/ stay untouched unless a one-line integration is strictly unavoidable.
- Keep the diff focused on the Files experience — no drive-by refactors.

## Deployment (final phase, only after the reviewer's PASS)
1. In /opt/forge-ai-os (the live checkout, NOT this worktree): git merge the project work branch into main. If the merge conflicts, STOP — leave the branch, do not force anything, and report the conflict in your final message.
2. Rebuild forge-control-web (pnpm install only if deps changed, then the build) and pm2 restart forge-control-web; restart forge-control only if its files changed. NEVER forge-executor.
3. Verify: pm2 shows both processes online, GET http://127.0.0.1:7700/api/health responds, and the web app serves HTTP 200 on its port (find it via pm2 env/ecosystem config).
4. Leave a summary of what changed and the before/after timings as the final task message.
